options: Camila’s dress is cheaper than mine.
I went to bed more earlier than usual.
Gustavo is more old than his brother.
Going by train is expensiver than by car.
My car is more fast than my sister’s car.
subject: Inglês
explanation:
A) Correto. Camila’s dress is cheaper than mine. - “Cheaper” é o comparativo regular de “cheap”. A estrutura “X is cheaper than Y” está correta.

B) Incorreto. I went to bed more earlier than usual. - Errada. “Earlier” já é um comparativo de “early”. Usar “more” com ele é redundante.

C) Incorreto. Gustavo is more old than his brother. - “Old” tem comparativo irregular: “older”, não “more old”.

D) Incorreto. Going by train is expensiver than by car. - Errada. “Expensiver” não existe. O correto é “more expensive”.

E) Incorreto. My car is more fast than my sister’s car. - Errada. “Fast” tem comparativo regular: “faster”. “More fast” está errado.
